# QODEQ

> QODEQ is an AI customer support platform for iGaming operators — online casinos, sportsbooks and lotteries. Five AI agents (chat, chat QA, payments, call QA, voice) share one knowledge base, one CRM context and one console. Typical result: 65%+ of player chats resolved without a human, support costs cut roughly in half, rollout in weeks.

QODEQ sells to B2B iGaming operators, not to players. Pricing is usage-based (per closed chat, checked chat, ticket or call minute) with no setup fee; the whole monthly volume is billed at the rate of the tier it falls into. The site is available in English and Russian.

## Products

- [AI Chat Operator](https://qodeq.net/chat): own LLM fine-tuned on 5M iGaming support chats; resolves KYC, bonus, limit and payout questions end to end, escalates to a human with full context. 65% resolved without a human, ~7-second replies. $0.30 → $0.18 per closed chat by volume (5K–30K, 30K–50K, 50K–100K, 100K+ chats/month), no setup fee.
- [AI QA System](https://qodeq.net/qa-chat): automatic quality control of 100% of support chats instead of a manual sample — 15 weighted criteria, 97.6% accuracy, daily per-operator reports. $0.30 → $0.18 per checked chat, no setup fee.
- [AI Payment Assistant](https://qodeq.net/payment): answers "where is my deposit / withdrawal?" with live PSP data, auto-creates tickets, checks PDF receipts for forgery. 45%+ of payment tickets resolved automatically. $0.30 → $0.18 per ticket, no setup fee.
- [AI Voice QA](https://qodeq.net/qa-call): transcribes and scores every inbound and outbound call (15 criteria) — 100% coverage instead of ~2.6% manual sampling. $0.30 → $0.18 per checked call (5K–30K, 30K–100K, 100K–200K, 200K+ calls/month), no setup fee.
- [AI Voice Bot](https://qodeq.net/voice): 24/7 multilingual outbound and inbound calls (deposit follow-ups, KYC reminders, win-back, payout calls), always on script. $0.30 → $0.18 per minute of conversation (up to 20K, 20K–50K, 50K–100K, 100K+ minutes/month), no setup fee.
- Platform bundle: contract the full platform and every plan on every product moves one step down — $0.25 / $0.20 / $0.18 / $0.15 instead of $0.30 / $0.25 / $0.20 / $0.18.

## Solutions

- [AI customer support for online casinos](https://qodeq.net/solutions/online-casino-customer-support): withdrawals, bonuses and KYC resolved in chat, 24/7, any language.
- [AI customer support for sportsbooks](https://qodeq.net/solutions/sportsbook-customer-support): bet settlement, voided bets, free bets and live-event peaks without a queue.
- [Support QA for iGaming](https://qodeq.net/solutions/customer-support-quality-assurance): every chat and call scored by AI instead of a 10–15% manual sample.

## Tools

- [Support cost calculator](https://qodeq.net/calculator): enter chat, payment-ticket and call volumes plus your operator cost; get monthly savings, payback and a PDF business case.
